newsitem.title: USA: CCC seeks up to 40,000 T HRW wheat for Armenia.
newsitem.headline: CCC seeks up to 40,000 T HRW wheat for Armenia.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Agriculture Department said it is tendering on June 19 for up to 40,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for export to Armenia.
The wheat was slated for June 30-July 15 shipment.
U.S. agents for Armenia said the tender was in combination with another for 1,500 to 2,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 program, Title One.
Shipment on the second tender was also June 30-July 15 with offers also due on June 19.
